full_judgment: 2. The facts of the case, in brief, are that respondents No. 1 and 2 as plaintiffs filed Title Suit No. 389 of 1981 against appellants No. 1-4 and respondents No. 3 and 4 seeking declaration of 'Raiyati' right in respect of 8.85 acres of land appertaining to C.S. Khatian No. 34 corresponding to S.A. Khatian No. 215, Plot Nos. 99, 100, 101, 122 and 123 and for further declaration that 5 kabala deeds dated 19.12.1978 purported to have been executed and registered by their mother Saraswati in favour of the appellants and respondent Nos. 3 and 4 are void, forged, without consideration, collusive and not binding upon them. They stated to the effect that land measuring 8.85 acres recorded in the name of Shamamoyee, their maternal grand mother, was inherited by her from her husband. On the death of Sharnamoyee her daughter Saraswati inherited the said property and her name was duly recorded in the S.A. operation in Khatian No. 215 of Monza Zilbunia; that Saraswati did neither execute the said sale deeds on 19.12.1978 nor presented the same for registration at the office of the Sub-Registrar, Rahamatpur under police Station Babuganj, Barisal. They claimed that they are in possession of the land.
